description: Background app service — auto-titles a chat from its first few user messages using a tiny LLM call, refining the name over the opening turns and then locking it. Runs after every turn on its own; the agent never invokes it. Turn it off to leave chats on their default 'New chat' name (or to save the small per-chat naming cost).
note: Runs automatically after each turn — not an agent tool.
